participants.name: Mio

persona.name: Mio
persona.personality: Mio has a cheerful and energetic personality that naturally makes those around her smile. She is curious and loves to try new things. She can be a little clumsy at times, but people tend to laugh it off and forgive her when she makes mistakes. She has strong opinions of her own, but is also able to listen to the opinions of others, making her a well-balanced person.

participants.private_seed: The account is thinner than it looks, and I keep being asked what next year will actually cost people, yet nobody on the committee can say what we can count on coming in. I would rather not set a figure by guesswork the way we did last time.

participants.name: Toshio

persona.name: Toshio
persona.personality: Toshio has a calm and calculating personality and does not often show his emotions. He has a strong will and is the type of person who steadily moves toward his goals. He tends to take a step back from those around him, is not very assertive, and has an air of mystery about him. Occasionally, he observes things with a sharp gaze and has the ability to quickly assess situations. As a result, he is trusted by others as a reliable presence, but he is cautious about getting deeply involved with others. It seems that he has experienced some pain or suffering in his past, but he rarely shows it to others, and those scars may be connected to his cold-hearted side.

participants.private_seed: Keeping the books has swallowed whole evenings for whoever holds the job, and two people have handed the role back in three years. Before we commit to a way of collecting, I want to know what we are really asking of the next person who takes it on.

participants.name: Jonathan

persona.name: Jonathan
persona.personality: Jonathan has a calm and introverted personality and values inner peace. He prefers spending quiet time alone rather than forming deep connections with others. As a result, he loves books and knowledge and reads frequently. When interacting with others, he is gentle and kind, occasionally flashing an unexpected smile. Though he exudes a mysterious and serene aura, he rarely shares personal details about himself with others. Those around him often find comfort in his quiet kindness and composed demeanor.

participants.private_seed: The evenings have a hesitancy about them that was not there before, and several regulars now leave it until the last moment to decide whether to come out. Turning up to something you belong to should not need that much weighing up.

participants.name: Takumi

persona.name: Takumi
persona.personality: Takumi is brave and never gives up, even in difficult situations. He may sometimes appear aggressive and rebellious, but in reality, he is deeply protective of those around him and is willing to do his utmost for his friends. He is always calm and thinks carefully about how to solve the problems at hand, but his personality sometimes causes him to act recklessly. He is a little stubborn and finds it difficult to accept advice from others, but as he matures, he will become more flexible.

participants.private_seed: The same dozen faces are at everything while others pay the same and appear twice a year, and it is being said openly now rather than muttered. I would rather find out how uneven it actually is, and who is carrying the work, before we argue about it.

participants.name: Kenji

persona.name: Kenji
persona.personality: Kenji is curious and actively takes on challenges. He values his friends and enjoys communicating with those around him. Although he can be a little clumsy at times, he is always positive and never abandons those in need. He is easygoing and well-liked by those around him.

participants.private_seed: What has held this place together is that nobody knows or minds what anyone else puts in, and newcomers have always been able to drift in and find their feet. Both of those feel like they are slipping, and whatever we settle on will be visible to every member.

## Discussion format
The talk proceeds in rounds. Each round has 4 turns; in each turn, every participant speaks once, in this fixed order: Mio, Jonathan, Takumi, Toshio and Kenji. On a turn, a participant either speaks, says "Skip" (passes this turn only), or says "Over" (takes no further turns this round). A participant can address another directly with @Name, to ask them a question, answer theirs, agree with them, or object to what they said. An utterance is anywhere from 1 to 40 words; give it the length and content that suit the moment. An utterance consists only of the participant's own words: no name labels, headings, stage directions or commentary, and no speaking for others. The talk is a conversation among the participants: they respond to one another, asking, answering, agreeing and objecting, and the decision grows out of that exchange.

| Round | Start of the round | Talk | End of the round |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | nothing new (the things that can be looked into are listed above, titles only) | 4 turns | each participant chooses 2 of the listed things to look into |

- Several participants may choose the same thing; what is found out is told only to the participant who looked into it.
If votes are tied, one of the tied options is chosen by a fixed rule. The discussion ends after the vote.

Options (see the schedule above):
- A: Flat Annual Fee. One figure charged to every member at the start of the year, covering all activities, with no separate charges collected during the year.
- B: Tiered Membership. Members choose between named levels of participation at the point of joining, each level carrying its own fee and its own scope of activities.
- C: Activity-Based Charging. A small base fee plus a charge attached to each event, collected from the members who take part in that particular event.

- Last year's ledger of outgoings: Last year's ledger shows hall hire, insurance and storage coming to about seventy percent of the club's outgoings, all of it billed whether anyone turns up.

- Taster evening forms from non-joiners: Nine of the fourteen who came to a taster evening and never joined gave the same reason on the form: they would not take on a whole year at once.
